description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. M. C. Kalyanavathi was elected as the member of the 6 Kehelwarawa of Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a party member ceasing membership. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and declarations related to local government elections.
